title: ByteDance Lucida indoor video to editable 3D asset meshes
summary: Japanese recap of ByteDance Seed Lucida research parsing indoor video into a scene graph, generating separate editable meshes via Seed3D 2.0, and placing objects with a VLM-driven GizmoAct 3D editor loop.
question_it_answers: How does Lucida turn indoor walkthrough video into editable per-object 3D meshes?

claims.text: Lucida reconstructs indoor video into editable 3D scenes using a VLM and Seed3D 2.0 with object detection and pose alignment.
claims.subject: image-to-3d-world

claims.text: Project-page table: scene-level detection AP on R2S-Scene is 0.592 (Ours key) versus 0.351 (Boxer all). Tweet 0.592 vs Boxer 0.351 matches this first-party row.
claims.evidence: GET https://lucida-r2s.github.io/ 200 25570 B. Table: R2S-Scene All objects Ours key 0.592 vs Boxer all 0.351.
claims.subject: image-to-3d-world

claims.text: arXiv:2608.30821 abs (200 / 43,008 B, submitted 2026-08-31): Lucida is parse → generate → place. Placement is GizmoAct, a VLM that edits an object gizmo in a closed loop. Abstract integers: mAP +69% vs Boxer on R2S-Scene; ADD-SB@0.05 57.8% → 83.4% on CA-1M; scene F-Score 0.794 (SAM3D) → 0.924. PDF listed 31,154 KB. Seed3D 2.0 is in the JP tweet, not in this abstract.
claims.evidence: GET https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30821 200 43008 B. Title Lucida: Parse, Generate, and Place for Composable Real-to-Sim Scene Modeling. Authors Qin et al. ByteDance Seed / PKU / ZJU.
claims.subject: image-to-3d-world

claims.text: Project page https://lucida-r2s.github.io/ is 200 / 25,570 B. Parse builds a scene graph (keyframes, masks, partial clouds, 3D boxes). Generate synthesizes an occlusion-free object image then lifts it to an editable mesh. GizmoAct uses up to four views and 12 refinement steps. No weights/repo URL (author user OrangeSodahub only). Thread is captured_full (1/1).
